summary: Steel Oregon Dept. of Forestry lookout built 1954 on Clatskanie Mountain; moved in 1984 to Magness Tree Farm and in later years to Hopkins Demonstration Forest, Beavercreek.

facts.design: Steel Aermotor tower with a 7 by 7 foot cab and catwalk
facts.status_note: An exhibit at Hopkins Demonstration Forest; moved from Clatskanie Mountain in 1984, then to Hopkins after a 2008 agreement
facts.agency: Forests Forever, Inc. (operates Hopkins Demonstration Forest)

access.note: Operator planned to open the tower to students and the public in 2021; current hours and climbing rules not confirmed

visit.trail_note: As of a 2020 visitor's page, at the edge of the Hopkins Demonstration Forest parking lot; reached by road from Oregon City

events.note: Erected by the Oregon Department of Forestry on Clatskanie Mountain, north Oregon Coast Range east of Astoria; steel Aermotor tower and cab
Decommissioned in June 1984 and moved to Magness Memorial Tree Farm, where the World Forestry Center ran it as an exhibit. The register says near Woodburn; the operator says near Wilsonville.
June 2008 agreement between Forests Forever, Inc. and the Oregon Department of Forestry to relocate the tower to Hopkins Demonstration Forest
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register (US 679) on September 23, 2010
Fire Tower Restoration (Bloomingdale, New York) crew rebuilt the cab on top of the steel tower in December 2019
Hopkins volunteers replaced stair treads, railings and safety fencing for public access, during the pandemic year (year inferred from the article)

corrections.why: 2010 is the register's registration date (September 23, 2010). The register and the Hopkins operator both say the tower was erected in 1954 by the Oregon Department of Forestry.

corrections.current: Moved from Clatskanie to Hopkins Forest.
corrections.proposed: Moved in June 1984 to Magness Memorial Tree Farm; June 2008 agreement to move to Hopkins Demonstration Forest.
corrections.why: The operator's account shows an intermediate stop at Magness Memorial Tree Farm from 1984 until the move to Hopkins.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 2010 is the register's registration date for the site, not the build year. The tower was erected in 1954, per the register and the Hopkins operator.

notes_for_editor: Build year: the record's 2010 built is the register's registration date (Sept 23, 2010); the tower was erected in 1954 per the register and the operator (correction proposed). Height: the operator says 65 ft (19.8 m, used in facts); Cheryl Hill's 2020 page says 60 ft (18.3 m, the record's current value). Unresolved. The operator's news article carries the header date Feb 6, 2017, but it describes December 2019 work and 'this past pandemic year', so the header date looks wrong (likely 2021); the story does not rely on it. Magness Tree Farm: the register says near Woodburn, the operator says near Wilsonville; unresolved. Current opening and climbing rules were not verified; the last source is the 2021 plan. Agency: the record's agency is Forests Forever (current operator); the original builder was the Oregon Department of Forestry. Reads used: 4 distinct pages (FFLOS register, Hopkins news article, Cheryl Hill post, one cached Oregon Lookouts index) plus a second cached Oregon Lookouts index with no detail; 0 WebSearch used for this tower.
